note: Mini-game art for Tangkap Buah (catch the fruit) and Pecah Belon (Yang, 18 Nov 2026). Same pipeline as assets-src/home: Codex on plain white, then `py -I scripts/home-art-to-webp.py assets-src/minigames/minigames-prompts.json`. Balloons are drawn in code. Words are drawn in code on top of the fruit. An item's optional "clear" lists [x,y] points (in the 1024 px PNG) inside white holes enclosed by the outline (e.g. a basket handle) that must also become transparent.
style: Flat cartoon game illustration in a bright, cheerful, child-friendly style for a mobile game for Malaysian primary school children aged 9: soft rounded shapes, clean dark-brown outlines, glossy flat colours with light shading. A single object centred on a plain solid pure white background (#FFFFFF), no shadow, no ground, no scenery. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, words or signs anywhere in the image.

items.scene: One ripe rambutan fruit: a round, bright red fruit covered in soft curly green-tipped hairs, with a short green stem and one small green leaf on top. Plain and blank (no face). Fills about 80% of the picture.

A woven rattan fruit basket seen from the front, wide and shallow with a curved handle on each side and a simple pattern of woven stripes in warm tan and brown, with a little green leaf tucked at the rim. Empty. Fills about 85% of the picture width.
